x: On the same evening that John Dunsford was at West London Stadium, competing in the Middlesex 10 km Championship, Mrs. Dunsford took son Jonathon over to the Essex Championships to compete in a boys race (which he won) and ended up competing in a women's 1 mile race.
Five races were the order of the day and a Dunsford in all but one. First off, in the Boys 3km, was Jonathon Dunsford who finished 3rd.
Helping to run the meeting as she has done for the last three years was Mrs Dunsford, who ensured that full details of each race were available within 15 minutes of the end of each race.
